title: Staged Launch Capacity Commitment Ledger
content:
Purpose and scope:
This working ledger captures the commitments, gating criteria, and contingency buckets for small-batch and staged launches. It is intentionally operational (less polish) — the goal is to make decisions visible for product, eng, SRE, sales, and CS as we ramp traffic across Dedicated and Hosted tiers.

Primary goals:
- Ensure each staged tranche has a committed capacity reservation and a named engineering on-call + escalation path.
- Surface KPIs tied to each gate (latency P50/P95, error rate, cost per 1k tokens, successful-response-rate).
- Define concrete rollback/fallback triggers and ownership.
- Preserve budget guardrails and chargeback mapping for Dedicated pools.

High-level rollout plan (staged cadence):
1) Alpha (internal partners) — 1% traffic; 1-week soak.
 - Capacity commit: 1 GPU partition (c6-like), baseline batch size config A.
 - Owners: Product: Maya; Eng: Jordan; SRE: Diego.
 - Gate KPIs: P95 < 250ms extra p99 cold-start margin; error rate < 0.3%
 - Contingency: pause ingress and redirect to canary-model; 1-hour mitigation SLA.

2) Beta (selected customers) — 5% traffic; 2-week ramp with daily checks.
 - Capacity commit: scale to 3 partitions; reserve warm cache nodes.
 - Owners: add Customer Success: Ellen for onboarding.
 - Gate KPIs: P95 < 200ms; end-to-end success rate > 99.2%; cost delta within forecast +/- 12%
 - Contingency buckets: degrade to lower-precision quantized model; apply tighter batching to reduce unit cost.

3) Gradual public rollout — phased weekly increases (5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%).
 - Capacity commit: staged Dedicated pool increments (see ledger below).
 - Owners: product ops to coordinate weekly go/no-go with deck.
 - Gate KPIs per tranche: define and sign-off 48h before tranche.

Capacity commitment ledger (snapshot):
- tranche-alpha:
  committed-gpus: "1 x A100-equivalent partition (reserved for 7 days)"
  warm-cache-nodes: "0 (cold start accepted)"
  budget-holder: "Product-ops budget line #2043"
  backup-capacity: "1 x low-priority spot partition (preflight only)"

- tranche-beta:
  committed-gpus: "3 x A100-equivalent partitions (auto-scale throttle at +1 partition/hr)"
  warm-cache-nodes: "2 (KV prefix caching enabled)"
  budget-holder: "Customer Success trial fund"
  backup-capacity: "2 x low-priority spot partitions (pre-provisioned)"

- tranche-1-20pct:
  committed-gpus: "6 partitions (mix of dedicated + burstable)"
  warm-cache-nodes: "4"
  budget-holder: "Dedicated commit 2025Q1"
  backup-capacity: "cross-region fallback pool (manual shift)"

Gating criteria (detailed checklist to run 24–72 hours before tranche increase):
- Telemetry: confirm contiguous metrics for last 48 hours for P50/P95/P99 and error rate.
- Cost: projected cost delta for tranche <= committed budget tolerance.
- Rollout infra: warm cache hit-rate >= target; autoscaler tested under synthetic spike.
- Observability: dashboards created + alerting with playbook links; traces sampled at 5% for new model.
- Legal/Privacy: data flow checklist for Private customers (VPC connector verified).
- Support: CS runbook and onboarding checklist assigned to named CS lead.
- Exec comms: one-slide summary + slack channel created 

KPIs (primary monitoring signals):
- Latency: request P50, P95, P99 (ms)
- Reliability: successful-response-rate (%) and infra-originated-error-rate (%)
- Cost: cost-per-1000-tokens and spend burn vs forecast ($)
- Capacity utilization: GPU slot occupancy and queue-length distribution
- Quality: sample-eval-drop (A/B comparison to baseline)

Escalation matrix (quick):
- Sev-1 (P95 spike > 2x baseline OR error rate > 2%): SRE paging (Diego) -> Eng on-call (Jordan) -> Product lead (Maya) -> Exec on call if unresolved 60m.
- Sev-2 (cost overshoot > 25% forecast OR < 95% success rate for 2 hours): Product ops slack alert to owners -> consider traffic rollback.

Rollback and fallback playbook (condensed):
1) Pause new-tranche weight in traffic router.
2) If error source is infra, shift traffic to fallback model variant (lower memory) for up to 4 hours.
3) If cost spike without quality degradation, re-evaluate batching/quantization config and re-run cost sim; apply as hotfix if safe.
4) Post-mortem: 72-hour incident review and retrospective with root cause and follow-ups assigned.

Staffing commitments and windows:
- Week-of-release (tranche changes): on-call SRE and eng for 72 hours (day+night rotation) + product ops presence 09:00–18:00 PT.
- CS coverage: 2 L2 reps for initial 72 hours.
- On-call rota refs: see linked_artifacts JIRA PO-rotas.

Acceptance checklist template (to be completed per tranche):
- [ ] Capacity reserved and confirmed by infra finance
- [ ] Dashboards up and green (48h of data)
- [ ] Alert thresholds tuned and tested with synthetic failure
- [ ] CS runbook loaded and tabletop practiced
- [ ] Exec one-pager shared with stakeholders
- [ ] Rollback steps rehearsed and smoke-tested

Contingency funding buckets (quick notes):
- bucket-A: immediate burst credits for Dedicated pools (up to $15k)
- bucket-B: emergency dev hours (tranches > 20% ramp)
- bucket-C: customer credits for SLA remediation (pre-approved template)

Operational notes and open questions (work-in-progress):
- Need a small synthetic traffic harness that targets KV cache warm paths — current synthetic does not exercise edge-cases for cache eviction. Action: Jordan suggested adding harness by 2024-11-20 (JIRA POPS-4021).
- Confirm billing labels for Dedicated temp partitions so product ops can attribute spend quickly. Action: Priya to confirm with finance, due 2024-11-18.
- Should we require a separate legal sign-off for private deployment customers in EU region? Currently unclear — tag: legal-review.

Short-term tasks (next 2 weeks):
- Build tranche-beta smoke checklist and point people (owner: Maya)
- Create dashboards for per-route token cost (owner: Diego)
- Run a DR test of fallback model variant with 15% of traffic (owner: Jordan)

Notes to self / meeting fragments:
- "If we allow burstable partitions we need a clear on/off threshold otherwise cost explodes." — quick note from 2024-11-13 triage.
- Internal partners want a light-weight public-facing one-pager for customers explaining staged rollouts and expected UX — assign to Ellen.

Appendix: quick links to telemetry queries (placeholders)
- latency-query: metrics.affinity/p95?route=staged-launch
- cost-query: billing/api/costs?label=tranche-beta

---
This is a living operational ledger — update the tranche rows as we sign contracts and commit budget. Use the linked artifacts for rotas and formal runbooks when moving from in_review -> final.
